================================================================================
Standard: block comments only
================================================================================

select `a;b`, $$c;d$$ /* e; */ # f; g // h;

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

(source_file
  (statement)
  (statement)
  (statement
    (comment))
  (statement))

================================================================================
Standard: EXECUTE BLOCK and DO BEGIN without BeginEndBlocks
================================================================================

execute block as
begin
  x = 1;
end;
do begin
  x = 1;
end;

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

(source_file
  (statement)
  (statement)
  (statement)
  (statement))

================================================================================
Standard: WITH FUNCTION without BeginEndBlocks
================================================================================

with function f() returns int begin return 1; end select f();

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

(source_file
  (statement)
  (statement))

================================================================================
Standard: brackets without Brackets
================================================================================

select a[1], array[1,2], [a;b];
select 2;

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

(source_file
  (statement)
  (statement)
  (statement))

================================================================================
Standard: a package spec and a package body without BeginEndBlocks
================================================================================

create package pk as function one return number; end pk;
create package body pk as function one return number as begin return 1; end; end pk;

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

(source_file
  (statement)
  (statement)
  (statement)
  (statement)
  (statement))
